title: Power-of-Two Leaky Integrate-and-Fire Neurons for Event-Driven Vision-Language-Action Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.33658v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong capabilities in robotic manipulation, yet their reliance on dense, continuous-valued computation presents a fundamental challenge for energy-constrained deployment. Inspired by the sparse, event-driven signaling and temporal integration mechanisms of biological neurons, a promising alternative is to introduce spiking computation into VLA models. However, enabling such computation without restructuring pretrained policies or compromising closed-loop control remains an open challenge. To address this challenge, we introduce the Power-of-Two Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (PoT-LIF) neuron, which emits signed spikes with power-of-two amplitudes. By combining magnitude-coded spike events with residual-preserving membrane dynamics, PoT-LIF enables continuous information to be progressively represented through discrete spikes. The Heartbeat formulation further localizes this process within

translated_title: 用于事件驱动视觉-语言-动作推理的二次幂泄漏积分激发神经元
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作任务中展现了强大的能力，然而其对密集的连续值计算的依赖为能耗受限的部署场景带来了根本性挑战。受生物神经元稀疏、事件驱动的信号传递与时间积分机制的启发，一种有前景的替代方案是将脉冲计算引入VLA模型。然而，如何在不重构预训练策略、不损害闭环控制性能的前提下实现这种计算，仍然是一个悬而未决的难题。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了二次幂泄漏积分激发神经元，它能够发射幅值为二次幂的有符号脉冲。通过将幅值编码的脉冲事件与保留残差的膜电位动力学相结合，PoT-LIF使连续信息能够通过离散脉冲被逐步表示。Heartbeat公式进一步将该过程局部化于……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出二次幂泄漏积分激发神经元，通过发射二次幂幅值的有符号脉冲并结合保留残差的膜动力学，在不重构预训练策略的前提下将稀疏事件驱动的脉冲计算引入视觉-语言-动作模型，实现高效节能的机器人推理。
en_tdlr: We propose the Power-of-Two Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (PoT-LIF) neuron, which emits signed spikes with power-of-two amplitudes and residual-preserving membrane dynamics to progressively represent continuous information through discrete events, enabling event-driven spiking computation in vision-language-action models without restructuring pretrained policies.
